title: Reading Between the Lines
goal: Contrast surface appearance with underlying meaning using hedging expressions and stance adverbs.
grammar: hedging (en apariencia, aparentemente, en el fondo) and stance adverbs

items: I can contrast a surface reading (*en apariencia*, *aparentemente*) with an underlying meaning (*en el fondo*).
I can frame an interpretation with stance adverbs such as *francamente* and *precisamente*.
I can discuss reading between the lines, subtlety, connotation and frankness.
